en: A colorized historic postcard view of a tree‑lined road and small houses along a street. A path curves in the foreground with a park or green hillside on the left and a row of low buildings with red and brown tiled roofs on the right. In the middle distance there is a bridge crossing the road, and further back a church spire rises above the trees. The style suggests an early 20th‑century European townscape. The bottom margin contains printed captions identifying the location and the publisher.
